# Tabs > Segmented and browser-style navigation with a stable active indicator. This file matches the installed `tabs` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/tabs.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/tabs.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `button` - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/tabs-knobs`: `tabsKnobs`, types `TabsKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/tabs`: `TabsSurface`, `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTab`, `TabsPanel`, types `TabsProps`, `TabsListVariant`, `TabsListProps`, `TabsTabProps`, `TabsPanelProps`, `TabsSurfaceProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ### Connected surface ```tsx ``` ### Closable tab Pass onClose to a TabsTab to render its close button inside the tab, and closeLabel to name it, as in closeLabel="Close README". ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsPanel, TabsTab } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/tabs"; const editorFiles = [ { name: "index.tsx", description: "Application entry point." }, { name: "tabs.tsx", description: "Browser-style tabs with connected corners." }, { name: "theme.css", description: "Token-driven tab surfaces." }, ]; function ClosableEditorTabs() { const [openFiles, setOpenFiles] = useState(editorFiles); const [activeFile, setActiveFile] = useState("tabs.tsx"); const closeFile = (name: string) => { const index = openFiles.findIndex((file) => file.name === name); const remaining = openFiles.filter((file) => file.name !== name); setOpenFiles(remaining); if (name === activeFile) setActiveFile(remaining[Math.min(index, remaining.length - 1)]?.name ?? ""); }; if (openFiles.length === 0) { return ( ); } return ( {openFiles.map((file) => ( closeFile(file.name)} closeLabel={`Close ${file.name}`}> {file.name} ))} {openFiles.map((file) => ( {file.description} ))} ); } const releaseChannels = ["Stable", "Release candidate", "Beta", "Canary", "Nightly", "Experimental", "Long-term support"]; export function PrimitiveTabsExample() { return (

Camera and recording quality. {releaseChannels.map((channel) => ( {channel} ))} {releaseChannels.map((channel) => ( Builds published to the {channel.toLowerCase()} channel. ))}
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `tabs` - `indicator`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`) - `list`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-scrollable`, `data-single`, `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`), `data-variant` (`browser` | `default`) - `panel`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-ending-style`, `data-hidden`, `data-index`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-slide` (`panel`), `data-slide-exiting`, `data-starting-style` - `root`: `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-slide` (`scope`) - `surface` - `tab`: `aria-selected` (`false` | `true`), `data-activation-direction` (`down` | `left` | `none` | `right` | `up`), `data-active`, `data-closable`, `data-disabled`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`) - `tab-frame` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### tabs - `--cui-tabs-list-backdrop-filter`: `none` - `--cui-tabs-indicator-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-tabs-list-shadow`: `inset 0 0 0 var(--control-rim-width) var(--control-rim), var(--shadow-inset)` - `--cui-tabs-indicator-background-image`: `none` - `--cui-tabs-surface-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-tabs-surface-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3.5)` - `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-start`: `var(--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline)` - `--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline-end`: `var(--cui-tabs-trigger-padding-inline)` - `--cui-tabs-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-tabs-trigger-height`: `var(--control-h-sm)` - `--cui-tabs-list-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1)` - `--cui-tabs-list-radius`: `var( --nest-radius, calc(var(--cui-tabs-trigger-radius) + clamp(0px, calc(var(--cui-tabs-trigger-radius) * 1000), var(--cui-tabs-list-padding))) )` - `--cui-tabs-list-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-tabs-indicator-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-tabs-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-tabs-font-size`: `var(--text-label)` - `--cui-tabs-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)` - `--cui-tabs-active-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-tabs-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-tabs-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-tabs-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-tabs-scroll-fade-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 6)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/tabs - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/tabs.json
